connect_existing.planning_actions: Actions: parse_plan/search_defs/materials/preview/placement_candidates/auto_connect/repair_line/connect_existing/build_area/room_template. connect_existing joins one existing edge without construction; use x/y, direction, type and dryRun/confirm.
connect_existing.ui_unavailable: Native utility build UI is unavailable or its API changed; no connection fallback will run.
connect_existing.ui_dragging: A player drag is in progress; finish or cancel it before reconnecting.
connect_existing.native_path_rejected: Native UI did not accept the exact two-cell path; no release was attempted.
connect_existing.target_required: Both endpoints must be completed linear utilities in the requested layer, with no replacement reservation.
connect_existing.single_edge_required: connect_existing accepts only x/y and direction for one edge; area, path, id, prefab, material and steps options are not supported.
connect_existing.type_required: connect_existing requires an explicit type: liquid, gas, solid, wire or logic.
connect_existing.scope_invalid: The edge must be inside the visible active world; no changes applied.
connect_existing.pause_required: Pause the game before reconnecting existing utilities.
connect_existing.same_required: connect_existing currently requires the same prefab, material and network manager at both endpoints; mixed endpoints are not replaced.
connect_existing.target_changed: An endpoint or active-world/pause state changed before release; native commit was not attempted.
connect_existing.not_verified: Native UI did not produce the exact requested edge while preserving endpoint identities and other connection bits.
